name: TMF intelligence and production capability bundle
naming: Descriptive bundle title; no product rename. Existing project remains tmf-research.
purpose: Collect information, understand systems and opportunities, produce useful knowledge/design/document assets, and hand actionable work to the appropriate MC owners.

status_definitions.source-documented: Existing repository documentation/source describes this; not a fresh end-to-end verification in this bundle task.
status_definitions.observed-pilot: A bounded local path was exercised in this conversation; not general release or MC acceptance.
status_definitions.partial: Some source, artifacts or bounded functionality exist; the complete capability/acceptance is unfinished.
status_definitions.intended: Agreed intended use; no completed connected path is claimed.

capabilities.name: Research and investigation
capabilities.purpose: Understand, compare, build, audit and offer-service lenses; fast collection or bounded deep investigation; source comparison, contradictions and follow-up.
capabilities.acceptance: A repeatable investigation answers its stated question with readable sources and visible gaps.

capabilities.name: Specialists and optional TMF Council
capabilities.purpose: Select systems, full-stack, design-system, business, marketing/SEO, customer-service and domain perspectives to fit the job. A scrape and one specialist can be enough.
capabilities.acceptance: Selected roles receive the relevant evidence and return useful, reviewed contributions; role count is not a quality metric.

capabilities.name: Web and repository collection
capabilities.purpose: Public sites, domains, documentation, GitHub, source code and explicitly selected local files; static text collection plus optional browser capture through Crawlee. Python Crawlee remains an adapter option, not a required rewrite.
capabilities.acceptance: Retained originals, timestamps, source identities, failures and reproducible readback; one acquisition path can feed multiple job types.

capabilities.name: Actual REA software inspection
capabilities.purpose: Use the real REA repository/CLI for packages, SDKs, local software and controlled website observations. Keep static, runtime and derived findings distinct.
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve exact target/version, REA envelope, evidence IDs, limitations and the behavior actually exercised.

capabilities.name: Whole-system breakdown and audits
capabilities.purpose: Map components, owners, data, permissions, state, lifecycle, connections and workflows before recommending individual plugins. Work with any supplied system; MC/DSH is an internal use case.
capabilities.acceptance: A professional can follow the connection map and ordered implementation jobs without reconstructing missing assumptions.

capabilities.name: Plugin ecosystem planning
capabilities.purpose: Inspect installed capabilities and catalogs first; compare reuse, adaptation and composition. Determine manifests, dependencies, host/UI contracts, overlaps and lifecycle gaps.
capabilities.acceptance: Evidence-backed stack, compatibility gaps and lifecycle proof gates; Studio and Maintainer retain their responsibilities.

capabilities.name: Visual reference studies
capabilities.purpose: Real sites/apps, dashboards, widgets, screens, flows and illustrations, organized using existing source categories. Pinterest and Refs.Gallery support discovery of original sources.
capabilities.acceptance: Human sees the whole screen, its meaningful parts, palette/type and behavior; DESIGN.md connects the same evidence for the agent.

capabilities.name: Motion and scene studies
capabilities.purpose: Keep motion playable and separate from static screen evidence. Study triggers, states, responsive behavior, camera/scene layers and interaction sequences where observable.
capabilities.acceptance: Observed interaction and retained evidence identify what is known; still images do not establish timing or editable scene source.

capabilities.name: Design-to-build handoff
capabilities.purpose: Produce linked visual parts, DESIGN.md, tokens/component JSON and reconstruction guidance. Optional independently implemented components have contracts and live examples.
capabilities.acceptance: Use a couple of packs in a separate real build, then test design tools and MC canvas editing/save/reopen before scaling.

capabilities.name: Professional software and workflow references
capabilities.purpose: Accounting/QuickBooks-style products, invoicing, reconciliation, CRM, support, payroll/tax, inventory, ecommerce, payments, office operations and workspaces.
capabilities.acceptance: Combine interface references with data, workflow states, validation, exceptions, permissions, integrations, audit trail and operational requirements.

capabilities.name: Market, competition and offer discovery
capabilities.purpose: Break down demand and competition, what sells in AI automation, trends, positioning and gaps. Compare evidenced current delivery capability against market needs before choosing prospect criteria.
capabilities.acceptance: A specific offer, buyer problem, differentiation and evidence-based delivery/readiness gaps emerge from the analysis.

capabilities.name: Prospect and contact intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Find businesses from research or supplied domains; collect public business contact routes, emails and phones with provenance; deduplicate and qualify for the specific service.
capabilities.acceptance: Audit a real sample row by row. Explain priority, disqualifiers and missing information; do not present a heuristic as a calibrated purchase probability.

capabilities.name: Explicit buyer-need discovery
capabilities.purpose: Find real requests/problems through supported public access to LinkedIn, Upwork, Fiverr, X and other relevant sources. Separate buyer requests from job listings, complaints and seller advertisements.
capabilities.acceptance: Original request, date, stated constraints/budget and legitimate response route are retained; each platform needs a demonstrated access path.

capabilities.name: Service readiness and product blueprints
capabilities.purpose: Audit opportunities, customer service/call-center automation, commerce, payments, office management, payroll/tax and security/assurance requirements. Define sellable scoped services and professional software specifications.
capabilities.acceptance: Requirements, prerequisite skills/providers, acceptance, costs, support, risk and delivery ownership are explicit; research does not certify compliance or establish readiness.

capabilities.name: Role and job knowledge packs
capabilities.purpose: Human-readable operational guidance plus versioned RAG-ready chunks, examples, decision rules, provenance, jurisdiction/product scope, freshness and approval.
capabilities.acceptance: A realistic task retrieves the right passages, respects access/scope, recognizes gaps/staleness and improves a worker outcome.

capabilities.name: Agent creation and professional role enablement
capabilities.purpose: Help define professional roles, job knowledge, tool requirements and evaluations; make knowledge available to the existing agent creator and role infrastructure.
capabilities.acceptance: Create a role through its existing owner and prove access to the correct pack/tool set. Builders and agents remain separate.

capabilities.name: Knowledge/database organization
capabilities.purpose: Normalize evidence, chunks, references and artifacts for existing MC stores and client-scoped knowledge. Preserve ownership, deduplication, revisions and retrieval identifiers.
capabilities.acceptance: Reviewed ingestion and retrieval readback work through the existing owner; no competing database or TMF Brain Engine access.

capabilities.name: Real document production
capabilities.purpose: Purpose-specific Markdown/HTML, PDF, DOCX, XLSX/CSV, PPTX, diagrams and builder JSON; briefs, audits, specifications, company intelligence, proposals and knowledge packs.
capabilities.acceptance: Generate a real file, retain editable inputs and citations, open/read it and save/reopen it with a supported tool.

capabilities.name: Current-topic and financial intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Watch technology, AI services, products, markets, stocks and crypto; produce sourced dated comparisons, risk/uncertainty and current summaries.
capabilities.acceptance: Show source date, observation time and scope; informational research does not imply execution of trades or account actions.

capabilities.name: Recurring collection and refresh
capabilities.purpose: Bounded schedules for references, market/source changes, leads and knowledge refresh. Reuse unchanged evidence; queue a relevant specialist after collection.
capabilities.acceptance: A scheduled job has finite budgets, lifecycle/stop handling, failure receipts, change detection and quiet notifications when unchanged. Visual scale-up is currently paused.

capabilities.name: Builder tickets and operational handoff
capabilities.purpose: Produce ordered implementation tickets, prerequisites, contracts and acceptance tests. Intended MC automation can trigger work on incoming builds and check repair/backlog tickets during downtime.
capabilities.acceptance: Existing builder/ticket owners receive and acknowledge the job, execute it and return real proof; research does not replace the builder runtime.

capabilities.name: Reusable workflow recipes
capabilities.purpose: Support simple collection-to-specialist jobs and richer node workflows for complex builder work; evaluate existing Paperclip/workflow plugins before inventing an engine.
capabilities.acceptance: One complete job runs through existing workflow/tool owners with observable stages, cancellation, durable state and recovery.

capabilities.name: Quality, context and learning from outcomes
capabilities.purpose: Keep reviewed versions, failed captures, corrections, successful retrieval/build results and feedback. Use them to improve future selection, packs and evaluation.
capabilities.acceptance: Measure supported claims, task completion, retrieval quality, useful contacts/build outcomes and cost. Stored activity is not proof of learning or model training.

capabilities.name: Connected MC use
capabilities.purpose: Link & Sync connects capabilities and lifecycle; Canon supplies context; existing role/KB/ticket/tool owners consume results; canvas hosts visual work and actual editors.
capabilities.acceptance: In real MC: select sources/packs → authorized tool use → build/edit on canvas → save → reopen/restart/reconnect → stop safely, with readback.

capabilities.name: Standalone product and TMF service offering
capabilities.purpose: Keep the MIT project useful outside MC with installation, configuration, examples and real exports. Show its added value inside TMF Systems and use real results for marketing.
capabilities.acceptance: A new user can install and complete a useful job. Publish only supported claims and appropriately licensed material; demand/revenue are not established by this bundle.

job_contract.status: proposed cross-job contract, not an installed scheduler API
rules: Completion, review and acceptance are separate.
No page/source text selects shell commands or grants authority.
External actions require their own authorization and operation-specific reconciliation.
Never overwrite accepted knowledge or user artifacts silently.

roles.lead: Scope, route and coordinate only as deeply as needed.
roles.council: Optional critical perspectives for complex or consequential questions.
roles.reviewer: Check support, coverage, limitations and readiness.
roles.producer: Generate the requested real files and linked visual studies.
roles.consumer: User, authorized agent or builder through their existing owner.

integration_ownership.Link & Sync: Connections, capability availability and lifecycle contracts.
integration_ownership.existing knowledge owners: Approval, storage, client boundaries and retrieval.
integration_ownership.existing design catalog/MCP: Design-reference categories and retrieval; no second competing catalog.
integration_ownership.Plugin Studio: Assess/select/combine compatible donor parts into plugins.
integration_ownership.builders: Build, fix and integrate through the existing shared builder workspace and ticket system.
integration_ownership.agents: Assigned operational roles with their own profiles/grants.
integration_ownership.chat/canvas: Conversation in chat; visual tools, boards, previews and actual editing on the canvas.

current_priority: Preserve the existing overall app/library design; pilot builds stay separate.
Finish a couple of human-visible reference packs and test a separate build from their DESIGN.md files.
Review output quality before automating this design workflow or resuming scale-up.
Add professional business-software workflows and hidden requirements, not only marketing pages.
Prove design tools + packs + builder + canvas + persistence inside actual MC.
deferred_inputs: Locate the existing diagrams/plugin-information repository before substituting anything.
Recover the exact TMF-leads note/email through explicitly selected connected Outlook access when that job resumes.
Confirm current installed plugin/tool/grant readiness through Link & Sync; historical surveys are not live health.
commercial_boundary: Free MIT standalone product remains useful.
Connected design/knowledge production and custom integration are potential service value.
Pricing, willingness to pay, revenue and launch performance require actual evaluation.

snapshot.pilot: NK and PostHog packs plus an original separate Reference Desk build; build acceptance not complete
snapshot.reused_components: Independent story-card activation/host-selection proof exists; original 3D gallery source not recovered
